correctness.rationale: The object has a fully explicit ten-vertex graph and forbidden four-path face predicate. All 1024 masks are checked by two independent predicates; 390 nonempty simplices, 1380 codimension-one incidences and 187 discrete-Morse pairs are exhaustively verified. A Kahn topological sort visits all 390 face nodes, certifying acyclicity. All 187 integral chain-cancellation pivots have unit size; the only critical boundary is a displayed 13x2 matrix with an explicit -1 minor, giving primitive rank two. Because the Morse three-skeleton is a wedge of 13 three-spheres, its two 4-cell attaching maps are classified by the integral pi3=H3 lattice; a primitive rank-two sublattice cancels two spheres and leaves exactly 11. Independent direct boundary ranks agree modulo 2,3,5,13. All 120 S5 signed Lefschetz traces and exact Murnaghan–Nakayama character inner products verify the irreducible decomposition. The statement is a finite fixed-graph homotopy theorem; no inference from partial sampling or field homology alone is used.

originality.rationale: The original 2015 primary text introduces devoid complexes but its exact classifications are for paths/cycles and three-path avoidance on forests; the Petersen four-path case is not covered. The close Petersen two-independence result is a proper 260-face subcomplex (one sphere), not this 390-face cograph complex. A published ordinary four-cut complex of J(5,2) has the same numerical 11 S3 wedge but a different face condition and rational S5 character; the results do not imply one another. value.rationale: Induced P4 avoidance is the canonical cograph condition, the first forbidden-path case beyond induced maximum-degree-one restrictions; for a girth-five cubic graph it is exactly the star-forest-inducing complex. Petersen is the canonical smallest strongly symmetric non-tree cubic example and lies outside prior path/cycle devoid-complex classifications. The complete integral homotopy equivalence, nonpure facet profile, nontrivial eleven-dimensional S5 module with 6+4+1 Specht decomposition, and zero global invariant subspace are structural results not determined by prior matching/independence/cut homology or face counts. Its exact symmetry character is a natural reusable benchmark for cograph-avoidance topology; no general family claim is needed.
